system_description.narrative_title: China‑West Tech‑Industrial Competition and Supply‑Chain Reshaping
system_description.narrative_summary: The headlines coalesce around an accelerating strategic competition between China and Western states/firms to control advanced-manufacturing value chains — semiconductors, batteries, autos, shipbuilding and critical minerals. Governments are deploying trade measures, subsidies, defense procurement and national funds while firms restructure joint ventures, factory footprints and logistics; these interacting flows of goods, capital and information create feedbacks, time lags and nonlinear shifts in market access and resilience. As an open system, the story emphasizes flows (materials, technology, finance), adaptive actors (states, firms, markets), interconnections (chokepoints, joint ventures) and emergent systemic outcomes (reshored production, new trade routes, geopolitical frictions).
system_description.scope: Cross-border industrial and technology value chains (semiconductors, batteries, EVs, autos, shipbuilding), critical minerals and energy supply, state policies (trade controls, subsidies, defense procurement and national funds), corporate restructurings and investments, logistics routes and chokepoints, and market demand shifts that reallocate production and control.
system_description.super_system: The international geopolitical-economic order (great-power competition, multilateral trade and finance regimes, and global markets).
adjacent_subsystems: Financial & investment flows (private equity, sovereign funds, industrial subsidies)

variables.name: Advanced manufacturing capacity
variables.description: Measures the installed and operable production capacity for advanced-manufacturing sectors (semiconductors, batteries, EV components, shipyards) available to meet demand.

variables.name: Critical materials availability
variables.description: Measures the accessible supply (stocks, production, and secured imports) of critical minerals and precursor materials used in high‑tech manufacturing.

variables.name: R&D intensity in high‑tech sectors
variables.description: Measures the rate of investment and activity in research, development and innovation within technologies relevant to advanced manufacturing.

variables.name: Trade control and export restriction level
variables.description: Measures the breadth and strictness of trade controls, export restrictions and licensing regimes affecting technology and inputs.

variables.name: Industrial subsidy intensity
variables.description: Measures the magnitude and tempo of government financial support (grants, tax breaks, loans) directed to targeted industrial sectors.

variables.name: Defense procurement demand
variables.description: Measures the volume and growth rate of procurement demand originating from defense and security requirements for advanced industrial goods.

variables.name: Cross‑border capital flows
variables.description: Measures the net flows of foreign direct investment, portfolio capital and strategic financing into relevant industrial and technology sectors.

variables.name: Supply‑chain resilience
variables.description: Measures the system's ability to maintain material, component and information flows and recover from disruptions across value chains.

variables.name: Logistics chokepoint congestion
variables.description: Measures the degree of congestion, capacity stress and time delays at critical transport and transshipment nodes that affect trade flows.

variables.name: Joint‑venture and partnering rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and intensity at which firms form cross‑border joint ventures, licensing arrangements and strategic partnerships.

variables.name: Technology transfer rate
variables.description: Measures the pace and volume of technology, know‑how and skilled‑labor movements between organizations and across borders.

variables.name: Manufacturing relocalization rate
variables.description: Measures the speed and scale at which production footprints are relocated (reshored, near‑shored or diversified) across jurisdictions.

variables.name: Global demand for clean/high‑tech goods
variables.description: Measures aggregate market demand dynamics for goods that drive advanced value chains (clean energy technologies, EVs, AI hardware).

variables.name: Access to advanced equipment
variables.description: Measures availability and lead times for specialized capital goods and manufacturing tools required for advanced production processes.

variables.name: Investor risk perception
variables.description: Measures market and investor perceptions of geopolitical, regulatory and commercial risks affecting willingness to finance industrial projects.

variables.name: Regulatory scrutiny intensity
variables.description: Measures the degree and aggressiveness of regulatory review, competition/antitrust oversight and transaction screening in relevant sectors.

catalysts.title: US trade and subsidy push on solar & chips
catalysts.description: US policy package and trade actions to compete with China on solar panels and semiconductors, combining export controls and subsidies that reshape market incentives.
catalysts.rationale: “Trump unveils trade actions to compete with China on solar and chips”; implies combined export controls and subsidies.

catalysts.title: US $2B battery/materials funding awards
catalysts.description: Federal funding pledge and likely awards to battery and materials producers to build capacity and domestic supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: “U.S. Pledges $2 Billion for Battery, Materials Producers” / “Trump Administration to Award $2 Billion...”

catalysts.title: South Korea $3.5B chip fund launch
catalysts.description: State-backed semiconductor fund to accelerate semiconductor hubs, materials, parts and equipment development.
catalysts.rationale: “South Korea to launch $3.5 billion chip fund, speed development of semiconductor hubs”

catalysts.title: Samsung SDI buys GM stake in US battery JV
catalysts.description: Samsung SDI's buyout of GM's stake shifts ownership and control of an Indiana battery plant, altering production footprint and partnerships.
catalysts.rationale: “Samsung SDI ends GM battery JV, plans to take full ownership of Indiana plant” / “Samsung SDI Buys GM’s Stake in U.S. Battery JV”

catalysts.title: US backing of Australian rare-earth miner
catalysts.description: U.S. Department of Defense investment in Australian rare‑earths increases non‑China supply and allied upstream capacity.
catalysts.rationale: “US backs Australian rare earth miner to cut out China” / “Australian rare earth miner surges after U.S. Department of Defense investment”

catalysts.title: China expands Arctic 'Ice Silk Road' shipping routes
catalysts.description: China's Arctic shipping initiatives to bypass traditional chokepoints and reroute global trade flows, potentially shortening routes for some flows.
catalysts.rationale: “China bypasses shipping chokepoints with ‘Ice Silk Road’ through Arctic”

catalysts.title: South Korea airbase relocation for chip cluster (by mid‑2028)
catalysts.description: Planned relocation of a military airbase to enable a semiconductor cluster, unlocking land and infrastructure for fabs and suppliers.
catalysts.rationale: “South Korea's Lee wants military airbase relocated by mid-2028 for chip cluster”

catalysts.title: Hanwha bid for Austal's U.S. operations
catalysts.description: South Korean Hanwha's offer to buy U.S. shipbuilder operations could accelerate allied shipbuilding consolidation and technology transfer.
catalysts.rationale: “Hanwha Offers to Buy Builder of U.S. Navy Ships” / “Shipbuilder Austal gets $1.2 billion offer”

catalysts.title: Chile allows state copper miner to reinvest profits
catalysts.description: Policy enabling ailing state copper miner to reinvest all profits, potentially boosting upstream copper investment and supply.
catalysts.rationale: “Chile allows ailing state copper miner to reinvest all profits for first time”

catalysts.title: Glencore-backed rescue of Sherritt cobalt refiner
catalysts.description: Potential rescue or restructuring of a cobalt refiner could preserve refining capacity and maintain supply of battery precursors.
catalysts.rationale: “Glencore-backed group looks to rescue cobalt refiner Sherritt”

catalysts.title: US push to block advanced chips to sanctioned Chinese firms
catalysts.description: Political pressure and proposals to stop advanced chips reaching sanctioned Chinese firms, likely raising export controls and transaction screening.
catalysts.rationale: “Key Republican urges US to stop any advanced chips from reaching sanctioned Chinese firms”
